clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a Dog spell, create a 1/1 green Cat creature token.
clauses.evidence: probe casts only Crash Through and Staunch Shieldmate (no Dog or Cat): no trigger, correct. Tree [0] CastSpellEvent(SUBTYPE_EQ Dog + TYPE_EQ Creature, actor YOU) -> CREATE_TOKEN 1 Cat 1/1 colors G = canonical [B2b-cast-dog-create-cat]. Packs (live and this packet's tree via --draft): Alpine Watchdog cast -> exactly one 1/1 Cat, no Dog (PASS); the opponent's Watchdog -> no token (PASS)
clauses.issue: non-blocking: 'Dog spell' is read as a Dog CREATURE spell (the compiler's tribal-noun convention), so a Kindred Dog noncreature spell would not trigger it (none in M21; narrower, not stronger)

Each variant: mana G-1 R-1 W-1, card tapped, 2 damage = Dogs you control (you_dog + Rin and Seri, a Dog Cat; opp_dog not counted): you_bear/opp_flier/opp_bear/cats/dogs die, giants damage 2, Rin and Seri damage 2, you 20-2+2
